owner_calls.question: The D&W Void variants (Sabretooth, Toad, Juggernaut, Callisto, Azazel, Lady Deathstrike) are already the subject of an open merge/split call (out_25). If the owner splits them into their own records, should the Cassandra Nova's Henchmen stages proposed here go on those new records instead? Pyro's stays, since the wiki treats him as the same John Allerdyce.
options: Add the stage on the current merged records (as proposed)
Hold the variant stages until the split decision; apply only Pyro's
owner_calls.evidence: Each variant's step on file says 'A ... variant fights for Cassandra Nova in the Void'. Marvel Database files them as Earth-TRN872 characters.

owner_calls.question: At the end of X-Men: Days of Future Past (revised 1973), the government shuts the Sentinel program down and Trask is later arrested. By X-Men: Apocalypse, Xavier and Mystique are using the leftover prototypes as X-Men training gear. Does the program's shutdown end the Sentinels' Trask Industries stage?
options: [["Trask Industries", "X-Men: Days of Future Past"], ["Independent", "X-Men: Days of Future Past"]]
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men Movies wiki, Sentinels, revised timeline: 'the Sentinel program was shut down, and Trask was later arrested'. In Apocalypse 'Xavier and Mystique decided to use the prototype Sentinels that Trask had built in 1973 for training'. Status: Inactive (revised timeline). These are machines, and the record's own step marks them 'In custody', so this is left to the owner.
